No, "hair of the dog" (drinking more alcohol to treat a hangover) does not cure a hangover . It only temporarily masks or delays symptoms while slowing your body's recovery.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXqL8UD2K2Q092EV5BH8tfPEHfIQKgzwRIqeGs_H74gbz5GJ6PZA0sGwM61uRC0m6uhSOhCV18z3Bo_9GXt8L8DxdU1oXH4hEGUNY0noDQrenpTHlNjDRqQh6wR1vgjyzXKh4j46IU6A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF1x5y5tZof9FNdCH7K6cGJkPEdAoIeiH_V2EzF1qi58r-YEwFapixjhWxKpKdzxC1czbK_F0WMXvyQSjhzdAcP5sOBL95GPqt5kaP62OC5RBdCPtddKkwMMvORwCUBWmmmvLjWuUhX95DvBUgjSau7-KxxYjHP1gT6wP0RHq2hyQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXcPP9ZuL1fLT09WvUiK_SQcj3w3SB-OLnJsZvBCkMg2nm2MrKzZXiwPCibWC8Z3sJuA3JWrNAGotNXlAvvCz-x5VmffE4zvNkRTcC30XBPS5WCf0b66wCvNqmkV-X61QHJvJWlskrCLRVCMXlyH53)

### Why It Seems to Work Temporarily

- **Re-raising alcohol levels:** Adding more alcohol can briefly blunt discomfort or mimic mild withdrawal relief, though hangovers differ from true alcohol withdrawal.
- **Endorphin boost:** Drinking can temporarily mask pain or fatigue.
- **Slower methanol breakdown:** Ethanol competes with methanol for the liver enzyme alcohol dehydrogenase, which can briefly delay the formation of toxic byproducts from congeners.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXlRb18ZA_Vws6kAG6JPgHzofTJyG3TZ541nQLyaRA9FpAIH0X49uZcExCOpZshQL0GVOplMzhVukuYYK6Fx7o8Heza3P39tH1VJnTrxMIE6YfPeobveYOz_8E2iRfHtbHBSxZ1v317w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXqUOxIFANBjSk3q5FQuqb13Nze0vGLvUGCuFssmNi3rSTgBHTY14q3RyoNL-DHOfEEWicPV3PtodvIRSPaXEEiqdjtr5ON9CGIqdGxZkcWj7-9HWmkAS9D51ujf66hat2LZr7)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF14LUipvD-zZ8aNiARxOBEgLORcvkITCmUohfkw9s3xGvqfsD14IBQdEiwSi0IcaN9n95lcxWxcb2-BNuzoL9uz_NxzFKu2GItfE9ktL3X6DxhI4wppQPnjzmmqNaZxSRy4N_bdCWvo8zJIfQh6uR7Ptpj-fb-0ro_0-eZiUIkUSyxf3Ve8_-cNFiELk2K1pVCgOms_WlvCPfyc36fdJNiQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXz25WEJQ4U1XXMTT0CK1UU7rKDhVQjBrYDZZ08kMca94DmKnvm_PRAOkYszc_-nYXNyxqzpaDrsqdCs_1nxVFTvOJyBo2NQn6-Q5GtCQFUJyrREheqoOjjIx6AzG09HAiAozHuhJUJ4GweQ)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXX3gz2wK2Z91XcGKfUdRXN-nCPUorcbNAQMBWKfIkemiKClLK9AQR9zGxOPQdWwLY3ZedAMAx-MMiXuqR_fC-wc1zTwqf6SWAps_yomk8yG-LXXA1ObOGU4Usa-Zq575U-H4ZTEQO9XkQN3zg)

### Why It Backfires

- **Delayed hangover:** Once your blood alcohol drops back to zero, symptoms return—often feeling just as bad or worse.
- **Extra liver strain:** Your liver has to process even more alcohol, prolonging recovery.
- **Habit risk:** Regularly drinking to ease hangovers can reinforce unhealthy drinking patterns.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXnFFhvXq8qGk_t02cQbmS6Rx3lQy9Q7QfKXs_eaXwDp3xglhiNpMPMC1wGXw9P-73NmWdpng5FLZKc3aAIxcKNXhlxtd1yiRVscLQh10DaMuFjlBKcUcxkfSUJY1bOmXlpBh2WBNHJ2hfoY--enypD5LfpA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXlRb18ZA_Vws6kAG6JPgHzofTJyG3TZ541nQLyaRA9FpAIH0X49uZcExCOpZshQL0GVOplMzhVukuYYK6Fx7o8Heza3P39tH1VJnTrxMIE6YfPeobveYOz_8E2iRfHtbHBSxZ1v317w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXcPP9ZuL1fLT09WvUiK_SQcj3w3SB-OLnJsZvBCkMg2nm2MrKzZXiwPCibWC8Z3sJuA3JWrNAGotNXlAvvCz-x5VmffE4zvNkRTcC30XBPS5WCf0b66wCvNqmkV-X61QHJvJWlskrCLRVCMXlyH53)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXqL8UD2K2Q092EV5BH8tfPEHfIQKgzwRIqeGs_H74gbz5GJ6PZA0sGwM61uRC0m6uhSOhCV18z3Bo_9GXt8L8DxdU1oXH4hEGUNY0noDQrenpTHlNjDRqQh6wR1vgjyzXKh4j46IU6A)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXWDaLJFJQyRTW40t_fJn7kHZM-R3CZUnkhjOm6Z_ZIIPln-cE6mNbxTa6be83s5LNaXDimC0TCPb_FljMMc3__H6qnPE-7DxN7ZbR5hX5Cb5_wE6awhyME7Ug9HTOm-Iwfu_ESxKzgw)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXz25WEJQ4U1XXMTT0CK1UU7rKDhVQjBrYDZZ08kMca94DmKnvm_PRAOkYszc_-nYXNyxqzpaDrsqdCs_1nxVFTvOJyBo2NQn6-Q5GtCQFUJyrREheqoOjjIx6AzG09HAiAozHuhJUJ4GweQ)

On [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF14LUipvD-zZ8aNiARxOBEgLORcvkITCmUohfkw9s3xGvqfsD14IBQdEiwSi0IcaN9n95lcxWxcb2-BNuzoL9uz_NxzFKu2GItfE9ktL3X6DxhI4wppQPnjzmmqNaZxSRy4N_bdCWvo8zJIfQh6uR7Ptpj-fb-0ro_0-eZiUIkUSyxf3Ve8_-cNFiELk2K1pVCgOms_WlvCPfyc36fdJNiQ) , opinions on "hair of the dog" are mixed, with some people saying it briefly takes the edge off or only feels helpful for minor hangovers or tapering, while others argue it does not fix dehydration or underlying hangover causes. For more background on the phrase and its theories, see [Hair of the dog](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXqUOxIFANBjSk3q5FQuqb13Nze0vGLvUGCuFssmNi3rSTgBHTY14q3RyoNL-DHOfEEWicPV3PtodvIRSPaXEEiqdjtr5ON9CGIqdGxZkcWj7-9HWmkAS9D51ujf66hat2LZr7).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF14LUipvD-zZ8aNiARxOBEgLORcvkITCmUohfkw9s3xGvqfsD14IBQdEiwSi0IcaN9n95lcxWxcb2-BNuzoL9uz_NxzFKu2GItfE9ktL3X6DxhI4wppQPnjzmmqNaZxSRy4N_bdCWvo8zJIfQh6uR7Ptpj-fb-0ro_0-eZiUIkUSyxf3Ve8_-cNFiELk2K1pVCgOms_WlvCPfyc36fdJNiQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXqUOxIFANBjSk3q5FQuqb13Nze0vGLvUGCuFssmNi3rSTgBHTY14q3RyoNL-DHOfEEWicPV3PtodvIRSPaXEEiqdjtr5ON9CGIqdGxZkcWj7-9HWmkAS9D51ujf66hat2LZr7)

### What Actually Helps

- **Time and rest:** Your body needs time to clear alcohol and recover from poor sleep.
- **Fluids and electrolytes:** Sip water or electrolyte drinks to counter dehydration.
- **Bland food:** Eating easy-to-digest foods like toast, crackers, or bananas can help settle your stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF11DhUV9Pfe0nSXMtPuDikJQ6pqi611c8prHj2ovjrefto2fG_-uTRD5nHjEQxJI0KxdxsMnEdYYxgDdrs21pkUevZEPef4yRmTRCSX1tt-QgszBuHBVJDVU3XcYUZgJQq5h-3KVPlTe6k_GvA8AaqiHG7g31zvqy5SMQMO1pMA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF1x5y5tZof9FNdCH7K6cGJkPEdAoIeiH_V2EzF1qi58r-YEwFapixjhWxKpKdzxC1czbK_F0WMXvyQSjhzdAcP5sOBL95GPqt5kaP62OC5RBdCPtddKkwMMvORwCUBWmmmvLjWuUhX95DvBUgjSau7-KxxYjHP1gT6wP0RHq2hyQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXcPP9ZuL1fLT09WvUiK_SQcj3w3SB-OLnJsZvBCkMg2nm2MrKzZXiwPCibWC8Z3sJuA3JWrNAGotNXlAvvCz-x5VmffE4zvNkRTcC30XBPS5WCf0b66wCvNqmkV-X61QHJvJWlskrCLRVCMXlyH53)
